title: A fluorometric chemosensor for the sequential determination of Fe(III) and cefotaxime sodium in water samples, serum and commercial formulations: a computational and an experimental approach
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17574-17590
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09532H, Paper

An indole-based chemosensor (P1) was synthesized and characterized using FT-IR and 1H NMR and was investigated fluorometrically for the determination of various metal ions.
